lines.text: Hey, I'm Prince! I build full-stack apps and explore the future of AI.
I love building things end-to-end - from the first line of code to a
working product people actually use. Lately my curiosity is pointed at
the AI space, taking these tools beyond flashy demos into things that
genuinely work. I learn best by building - if I'm curious, I've probably
already started coding it. Check out my focus areas below.
